# Requirement Traceability Matrix

| Requirement ID | SPEC | Summary | Implementation | Unit test | Integration/conformance | Evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ST-...` | `SPEC-...` | ... | — | — | — | — | UNIMPLEMENTED |

## Status values

- UNIMPLEMENTED
- IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED
- PARTIALLY_VERIFIED
- VERIFIED
- BLOCKED
- NOT_APPLICABLE
- SUPERSEDED

## Rule

A requirement cannot become `VERIFIED` without a stable evidence reference.

Documentation text by itself is not verification.
